description: The main FastAPI application implementation for a certification management backend, including endpoints for health checks, certification job management, mappings, metadata, and webhooks, as well as background tasks and startup/shutdown events.

classes.name: HealthResponse
classes.description: Response model indicating health status and database connectivity.

classes.name: CertificationRunResponse
classes.description: Schema representing a certification job run status and details.

classes.name: GitLabWebhookPush
classes.description: Payload schema for GitLab webhook push events.

classes.name: RepositoryRef
classes.description: Schema for repository identification info for triggers.

classes.name: TriggerCertificationRequest
classes.description: Schema for request to trigger certification jobs.

classes.name: AirflowTaskEvent
classes.description: Schema for Airflow task webhook events.

methods.name: None _background_trigger_orchestration(run_id: str)
methods.description: Function to trigger orchestration of a certification job in background.

methods.name: CertificationRunResponse get_certification( run_id: str, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Retrieve a certification job by run_id.

methods.name: CertificationRunResponse create_certification( payload: TriggerCertificationRequest, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), request: Request = None, actor_header: Optional[str] = Depends(extract_actor_from_headers), )

CertificationRunResponse patch_certification( run_id: str, payload: PatchCertificationRequest, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), request: Request = None, actor_header: Optional[str] = Depends(extract_actor_from_headers), )
methods.description: Update fields of an existing certification job.

methods.name: List[MappingResponse] get_mappings( provider: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Filter by provider"), project_id: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Filter by project_id"), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: List branch-environment mappings with optional filters.

methods.name: MappingResponse post_mapping( payload: MappingItem, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), request: Request = None, actor_header: Optional[str] = Depends(extract_actor_from_headers), )

List[MetadataItemResponse] get_metadata( key: Optional[str] = Query(default=None), provider: Optional[str] = Query(default=None), project_id: Optional[str] = Query(default=None), branch: Optional[str] = Query(default=None), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: List metadata items based on filter parameters.

methods.name: MetadataItemResponse post_metadata( payload: MetadataUpsert, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), request: Request = None, actor_header: Optional[str] = Depends(extract_actor_from_headers), )

WebhookAck airflow_webhook( payload: AirflowTaskEvent, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), x_webhook_secret: Optional[str] = Header(default=None, alias="X-Webhook-Secret"), request: Request = None, )
methods.description: Handle Airflow webhook callbacks for job status updates.

methods.name: WebhookAck gitlab_webhook( payload: GitLabWebhookPush, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), x_gitlab_token: Optional[str] = Header(default=None, alias="X-Gitlab-Token"), x_webhook_secret: Optional[str] = Header(default=None, alias="X-Webhook-Secret"), request: Request = None, )
